description: Fires mostly when the board is left-heavy with column 2 empty (or one stone) between tall columns 1 and 3 (column 3 four or more high, column 0 also filled) and columns 4-6 short; also always right after an opening move in column 0. Strength depends strongly on who owns the lower stones (adding one far stone to flip the side to move often switches it off), so many such wells do not fire.
effect: none measurable (forcing it to zero or max changes move probabilities by at most 0.01 on 5 positions)
notes: Hypotheses: col-2 well depth (F1 0.115), well + last move (0.12), colour counts (0.10), well + left-heavy/right-light + opening-col-0 rule (0.25, chosen), + colour terms (0.254). Strong parity/colour dependence not captured; probes give contradictory per-column colour effects. Looks like a mixture of layer-1 token statistics. Steering effect negligible. Synthesis 1.869 beats dev max 1.704.
